name: Just-In-Time Activation - 15 Minute Reminder
description: Notifies a user that their Just-In-Time activation expires in 15 minutes.
subject: Your Just-In-Time access for ${entitlementName} expires in 15 minutes
body:
Just-In-Time activation expires in 15 minutes

Dear $__recipient.name,

Your Just-In-Time (JIT) activation will expire in 15 minutes. Please take action now if you still need this access.

#if($applicationName)

Application: $applicationName

#end #if($activationUrl)

You can extend or manage your access in $__global.productName here.

#end

Thank you,
The $__global.productName Team
